measurement.command: node --input-type=module -e "import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs'; import YAML from 'yaml'; const d=YAML.parse(readFileSync('docs/openapi/openapi.yaml','utf8')); const ops=[]; for (const [p,i] of Object.entries(d.paths??{})) for (const m of ['post','put','patch','delete']) { const o=i?.[m]; if (o?.['x-capability']) ops.push([m.toUpperCase()+' '+p, o['x-action-label']]); } console.log('guarded='+ops.length, 'labelled='+ops.filter(([,l])=>typeof l==='string'&&l.trim()).length, 'missing='+ops.filter(([,l])=>!(typeof l==='string'&&l.trim())).length)"
measurement.gapDefinition: Every capability-guarded write absent from all PAGE_REGISTRY.requiredApis is listed individually; no wildcard owner or ignore pattern is accepted.
measurement.capabilityGapDefinition: Each tracked page capability is absent from OpenAPI; the exact owning Volume 3 task and a one-line reason are recorded. A gap is invalid once any OpenAPI operation carries the capability.
